forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: b080
+title: 'The mlx-swift_Cmlx "missing creator for mutated node" build warning: find its source and remove it, so swift test can be green'
+---
+Every AVK build, in every tree and worktree, prints `warning: missing creator for mutated node: ('<.build>/out/Products/Debug/mlx-swift_Cmlx.bundle/Contents/MacOS')`. It has been there throughout this session's runs (268+ matches in the shell history). Deleting the bundle and rebuilding brings it back. The test contract counts a warning as red, so no `swift test` run can count as green, and reviewers leave "swift test is green" unchecked on every card (^ffeg9my, ^ah4w15m).
+
+## Work
+- [ ] Find which dependency brings in mlx-swift (`swift package show-dependencies`) and why: which AVK product or test target links it, and whether that link is needed.
+- [ ] If AVK doesn't need it, remove the dependency edge that pulls it in. If it's needed, find the fix in the mlx-swift version or in its resource bundle layout, and pin a version without the warning. If the fix belongs upstream, ask the owning session to make it (mlx-swift-lm sessions are running on this machine).
+- [ ] A clean `swift build` and `swift test` print no warnings.
+- [ ] `swift test` is green, with zero warnings.
+
+No suppression and no filtering of the warning.
\ No newline at end of file

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m61k5vmkjnekfq3nfgshf7pe
+  text: |-
+    ### implement — stuck (the fix is upstream; no AVK change)
+    - Dependency chains:
+      - AgentViewKit (library target) → FoundationModelsACPClient → FoundationModelsExtras (MLXModelLoader) → mlx-swift-lm@stable 1eb84ff → mlx-swift 0.32.3 Cmlx.
+      - DemoSupport → FoundationModelsACPAgent → FoundationModelsRouter → mlx-swift-lm.
+      Both links are needed, so AVK has no edge it can remove.
+    - Cause: Swift Build in Swift 6.4 marks `mlx-swift_Cmlx.bundle/Contents/MacOS` as mutated, and no task creates it. This happens for the resource bundle built from Cmlx's auto-detected .metal files, which has no executable.
+    - A clean build prints 77 warnings: 1 missing-creator and 76 Metal `-Wc++17-extensions` from mlx-swift's Metal headers. None comes from AVK. mlx-swift 0.33.0 and main don't fix it, and mlx-swift-lm caps mlx-swift at 0.32.x anyway.
+    - Owners of the fix:
+      - swiftlang/swift-build: the missing-creator bug.
+      - ml-explore/mlx-swift: a workaround (a build-tool plugin that builds default.metallib as a declared resource) and the Metal language version.
+      - Optional, swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsExtras: move MLXModelLoader into its own product, so the AVK library stops pulling in MLX. The demo still would, through the Router.
+    - No commit. The wt/mlx worktree and branch are removed. Until upstream changes, a warning-free swift build isn't possible here. The user needs to decide how the "zero warnings" test rule treats this.
